title: ICAO Annex 9 Standard 3.42 — Failure to Provide Written Reasons for Refusal of Embarkation
category: ICAO Standards Violation — Written Notice Obligation

confidence.note: V10 validated. V01: 1 segment unresolved (STG-5.seg-40). Single-article framework (Art. 37) with strong element grid (0.771). 10/10 authorities unverified. Confidence 0.66 is pipeline-derived; MD frontmatter previously carried legacy 0.94 from seed.

incident.location: Santiago International Airport (SCL), Gate Area, Chile

allegation_summary: Passenger [[SPK-passenger-leandro]] was refused embarkation on international flight LA8159 and ordered to deplane by LATAM crew without receiving the immediate written notice of reasons required by ICAO Annex 9 Standard 3.42. The verbal explanations provided were inconsistent: initially 'your conduct' (later disproven by PDI CCTV), then 'the presence of a colleague outside,' and finally a contradictory reference to self-service check-in by DGAC. At no point was the passenger provided with a written statement documenting the lawful grounds for refusal.

articles.article_name: Chicago Convention, Art. 37 — Adoption of International Standards and Procedures
articles.article_text: Each contracting State undertakes to collaborate in securing the highest practicable degree of uniformity in regulations, standards, procedures, and organization in relation to aircraft, personnel, airways and auxiliary services in all matters in which such uniformity will facilitate and improve air navigation.
articles.applicability_rationale: Art. 37 provides the treaty basis for ICAO SARPs but is aspirational. The direct violation is of Annex 9 Standard 3.42 itself. DGAC's failure to ensure operator compliance also engages Chicago Convention Art. 38 (notification of differences), which should be cited alongside Art. 37.
